issues.description: The type of the Person.birthday attribute is inconsistent: the problem statement and the template common model declare birthday as LocalDate, and the client UI expects a LocalDate, but the solution common model declares birthday as String. This mismatch will cause compilation errors in the client view code and confusion about the expected type when implementing serialization/deserialization or server-client interactions.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the Person.birthday type consistent across all artifacts. Preferably change the solution's Person.birthday back to java.time.LocalDate and update its getter/setter signatures accordingly so it matches the problem statement, the template model, and the UI code. If JSON serialization is required for LocalDate, register the appropriate Jackson JavaTimeModule or use ISO date strings consistently on both client and server. Alternatively, if a String is intentionally desired, update the problem statement, template model, and UI code to use String consistently and document the expected format.
